verdict.rationale: The clearest first-party evidence of a bulk operation is the Codex Security `bulk-scan` command, which reviews many repositories in a single campaign. Canvas view also lets a user comment on one or more images at once. Both are narrow, feature-specific capabilities rather than a general way to act on many items at once. Missing for 10: a general-purpose bulk-action capability across arbitrary items (files, chats, records), documentation of bulk-scan's limits and outputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Use `npx @openai/codex-security bulk-scan` to review repositories in one campaign.
In Canvas view, use Comment to add precise feedback to one or more images.
